SELECT locations.location_id, locations.location_name, COALESCE(SUM(orders.order_total), 0) AS order_revenue
FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."locations" AS locations
LEFT JOIN "jaffle_shop"."dev"."orders" AS orders ON orders.location_id = locations.location_id
GROUP BY locations.location_id, locations.location_name
ORDER BY order_revenue DESC, locations.location_name
LIMIT 500
